title: SKYE Form Config Overlay
description: Validates a permission-overlay form.config.json (skye_data/forms/[id]/[permission]/form.config.json). Structurally identical to the base form.config.schema.json except NOTHING is required at the top level — an overlay only needs to declare the pages/fields/postActions it's adding or loosening, per the additive-only merge convention documented in the base schema and README. Nested objects (a page, a field, a postAction) still require their own normal required keys when present — e.g. a field you do mention must still have controlType — matching how the two real overlay examples in this repo are authored (full field redeclarations, not single-key patches), which keeps overlay files easy for a non-coder to read top to bottom rather than needing to diff against the base file mentally.
